extraction.policy_summary: HCLTech states it has an equal opportunity policy as required under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, embedded in its Human Rights Policy (with a public web link) and its Code of Business Ethics and Conduct (COBEC), which includes a clause on equal opportunity. No disability-specific standalone policy document is described.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As of March 31, 2026: 1,269 total differently abled employees (1,263 permanent + 6 other-than-permanent), broken down as 970 male (76.44%), 291 female (22.93%), 8 others (0.63%). Separately, among FY26 outcome highlights, HCLTech reports a 27.4% increase in the number of differently-abled employees.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: HCLTech states it has developed disability-friendly infrastructure including ramps, voice-enabled lifts, PwD washrooms, reserved parking spaces, and emergency warning systems with audio and visual alarms, and has conducted third-party inspections to confirm facility accessibility. It also states its premises/offices are accessible to differently abled employees, workers, and visitors as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
extraction.digital_accessibility_measures: The company states its websites and internal portals comply with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.2) and that portals are regularly updated to improve accessibility. No specific conformance level (A/AA/AAA) is stated.
extraction.culture_practices_details: HCLTech operates an employee-led Ability Connect Network, an Employee Resource Group (ERG) described as supporting employees with disabilities and allies through accessibility initiatives and awareness-building. No participation numbers, activity cadence, or additional PwD-specific culture commitments (e.g., flexible-work or accommodation response-time pledges) are given.
extraction.compliance_details: HCLTech states its offices are accessible to differently abled employees, workers, and visitors as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, that it maintains an equal opportunity policy as per the same Act, and that its digital properties comply with WCAG 2.2. No RPwD Act statutory reservation/quota attainment percentage or specific WCAG conformance level is disclosed.
